lab.quote: And thanks to that, we have closed Q2 with a net order book of 251 billion.

lab.quote: So if you look at the quarter as a whole, we won 36 billion worth of new business, which is the 3rd highest quarter for order additions.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: New business wins in Q2 FY27 totaled 36 billion.

lab.quote: It's 4%, we are hoping in the decade to come, this becomes what EV has been for the last decade for us.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT

lab.quote: EV Suspension Motors was our fastest growing business this quarter, and I think it's already reached 7%.

call_memory.quote: EV Suspension Motors was our fastest growing business this quarter, and I think it's already reached 7%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: EV suspension motors business reached 7% of total revenue in Q2 FY27.

lab.quote: And together, if you take them, they have an annualized revenue run rate of 1400 crore.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Combined annualized revenue run rate for traction motors and suspension motors is 1,400 crore.

lab.quote: EBITDA margin was 23%, which was lower by 2.3% compared to the same quarter last year. The margin was lower primarily on account of change in the product mix and higher input prices. Which were partially offset by a positive impact of the operating leverage.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 declined by 2.3% year-on-year to 23%, primarily driven by changes in product mix and higher input prices, partially offset by operating leverage.

lab.quote: Traction motor demand has significantly exceeded even our own internal expectations. The business has grown almost 50% quarter on quarter. That has obviously pulled down the overall margin percentage a little bit.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Continued margin pressure driven by traction motor demand significantly exceeding internal expectations, growing 50% quarter-on-quarter and pulling down overall margin percentage.

lab.quote: Freight rates have also risen sharply, they've nearly doubled from the previous quarter's level.

call_memory.quote: Freight rates have also risen sharply, they've nearly doubled from the previous quarter's level.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Freight rates have nearly doubled from the previous quarter's level, contributing to cost pressures.

lab.quote: According to our calculation, cash to ebitda ratio as long as it doesn't go above 1.5. we don't have to rush into any decision.

call_memory.quote: According to our calculation, cash to ebitda ratio as long as it doesn't go above 1.5. we don't have to rush into any decision.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Net debt to EBITDA ratio continues to be in negative territory, and management stated that as long as the cash to EBITDA ratio does not exceed 1.5, they do not have to rush into any M&A decision.

lab.quote: Consequent to all these movements, as of end of September we had cash and investments worth 1,966 crores.

call_memory.quote: Consequent to all these movements, as of end of September we had cash and investments worth 1,966 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Cash and investments stood at 1,966 crores as of end of September 2026 on a gross basis.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Net cash stands between 1,400 crores to 1,500 crores as of end of September 2026.

call_memory.statement: Management stated that the aspiration does imply a 25% CAGR in the medium term.

call_points.text: EBITDA margin for Q2 was 23%, impacted by product mix and input prices.
Gross cash and investments stood at ₹1,966 Cr as of end of September.
Net order book reached ₹25,100 Cr with EV programs accounting for a major share.
EBITDA margin expected to stay in the 23-25% band post railway business consolidation.
Net order book stands at ₹23,700 Cr with EV programs accounting for 70%.
Commodity inflation in steel, aluminum, copper and petrochemicals puts lag-driven pressure on margins.
Gas consumption reduced by 20% by shifting partially to electric heating with zero production loss.
Suspension motors expected to achieve triple-digit growth next year, potentially touching double digits of revenue.
Novelic India entity set up with SMT lines ready; SOP scheduled for end of this year.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Writ Petition filed with the High Court, Madras The case is related to the period prior to the Amalgamation of Comstar Automotive Technologies Private Limited ("Transferor Company" or "Comstar") with Sona BLW Precision Forgings Limited ("Transferee Company" or "Company"), during which Comstar, a 100% EOU, availed an IGST refund of Rs. 28.19 Cr on exports made under various shipping bills in FY 2018-19 and FY 2019-20. The Department of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) alleged that the Company had simultaneously availed IGST exemption on imports while claiming export refunds. Further, a communication from the Commissioner of Customs stated that the refund was inadmissible under Rule 96(10) of the CGST Rules. The Company has filed a Writ Petition challenging the vires of Rule 96(10).
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Office of The Commissioner of Customs, Chennai
tax_litigation.status: The Writ Petition filed with the High Court of Madras and pending for further hearing and decision.
